description: This Rust source file defines a URLParameters struct for constructing and serializing URL query parameters, including encoding, JSON deserialization, and handling of single or vector values.

classes.name: URLParameters
classes.description: A struct for building URL query parameters with encoding and JSON deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new empty URLParameters instance.

methods.name: encode_and_push
methods.description: Percent-encodes a string and appends it to the URL parameters string.

methods.name: start_new_pair
methods.description: Adds '?' or '&' to the URL parameters string depending on whether it's empty.

methods.name: push_kv
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the URL parameters string.

methods.name: push_array_entry
methods.description: Adds an array entry for a key with a value.

methods.name: push_array
methods.description: Adds multiple array entries for a key from a vector of Values.

methods.name: push_single_or_vec
methods.description: Adds a single value or a vector of values for a key.

methods.name: add_from_json
methods.description: Parses a JSON string and adds corresponding key-value pairs.

methods.name: with_empty_path
methods.description: Returns the URL parameters string, defaulting to '?' if empty.

methods.name: append_to_path
methods.description: Appends the URL parameters string to an existing URL.
